name: Jakub Menšík
intro: Jakub Menšík is a very tall player from Czechia. He stands 6 feet 5 inches. At 19 he won a big title in Miami, beating his hero Novak Djokovic.
story: Jakub grew up right next to tennis courts. He watched other kids play, then joined in at age five. Later his idol Djokovic invited him to practice together. In 2025 Jakub beat Djokovic in the Miami final! He also just won a doubles title right here at the US Open.

funFacts.text: He just turned 21. His birthday is September 1.
Off the court he loves golf. His favorite ice cream is vanilla.
His favorite food is spare ribs.
His favorite book is Harry Potter and the Cursed Child.
He loves basketball star Stephen Curry and the Golden State Warriors.
His favorite city on tour is New York.
He taught himself the drums from YouTube videos. He can play Led Zeppelin songs!
Fans call him Menimal, a mash-up of Mensik and animal.

watchFor: Watch his rocket first serve, then his second serve that kicks up high.
